messages:
alex_p: Hey team — hitting a 500 when I submit the billing form in the Console. Error banner shows 'Internal server error'. I grabbed the request id from the UI: req_3f9b2a7c. Any repro steps you need?

maria_s (Support): Thanks — can you grab a network HAR + console log so we can see the failing request/response and stack trace? If you can't, the request id helps but HAR+console is ideal.

alex_p: I can do that. I'm on Chrome 118 on macOS Sonoma. What exact steps do you want?

maria_s (Support): Short checklist (Chrome):
1) Open DevTools (Cmd+Option+I).
2) In Network tab: check 'Preserve log' and 'Disable cache'.
3) In Console tab: make sure 'Default levels' checked so errors show.
4) Reproduce the flow (fill form -> submit).
5) Right-click inside Network list -> 'Save all as HAR with content' -> save .har.
6) In Console, right-click -> 'Save as...' (or copy visible errors).
7) Upload both files to the ticket or the support upload link we gave earlier.

maria_s (Support): Important: do NOT paste your full API key into the ticket. If the request contains an Authorization header, redact it (replace with <REDACTED>). Keep the request id (req_3f9b2a7c) intact.

alex_p: Can I use Incognito? I usually repro there to avoid extensions.

maria_s (Support): Yes, Incognito is fine — just make sure 'Preserve log' is enabled there too. Extensions are often the culprit, so incognito is preferred for clean repros.

alex_p: Also getting some latency spikes before the 500 — how do you want traces/headers?

maria_s (Support): If you can, include the full response headers for the failing request in the HAR. For quick repro we also accept a curl reproduction. Example curl you can run locally (replace placeholders):

```
curl -v \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "x-request-id: req_3f9b2a7c" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"amount":1000, "currency":"usd"}' \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/payments/charge"
```

maria_s (Support): That will show the raw response and headers. If curl returns 500, copy the full response and the curl stdout/stderr and attach.

alex_p: I can run that. Anything different for Firefox or Safari?

maria_s (Support): Firefox: Network tab -> right-click -> 'Save all as HAR'. Console -> save text. Safari: enable Develop menu (Safari -> Settings -> Advanced -> Show Develop menu). Develop -> Show Web Inspector -> Network tab -> right-click a request -> 'Export HAR'. Safari HAR can omit some fields but still helpful.

sre-bot: Reminder: if the HAR includes customer PII (card numbers, emails), redact before upload. Use the support upload link with the ticket number.

maria_s (Support): After you upload, reply here with the file names and the ticket link. We'll triage and pull logs from the backend using the request id; HAR helps tie frontend -> backend.

alex_p: Uploaded both: billing-500-req_3f9b2a7c.har and console-billing-req_3f9b2a7c.txt to https://support.redwood.com/ticket/7892 — let me know if you need anything else.

maria_s (Support): Received. We'll start investigating and loop in runtime SRE if we see resource/latency patterns. Thanks for the quick repro! :thumbsup:
